subject.title: chore(autoreview): sync hardened org review defaults

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the canonical autoreview interface that removes four reviewer engines and makes GPT-5.6 Sol/high the default with Terra used only for recognized account-access failures?
rationale: Exact canonical parity, green checks, and upstream contract compatibility establish implementation quality, but they cannot authorize deliberate changes to established maintainer commands and operational defaults.

options.title: Adopt canonical policy
options.body: Merge the exact canonical tree and accept Codex, Claude, and Pi plus Sol/high with the narrow Terra access fallback as the supported organization-wide workflow.

options.title: Revise policy upstream
options.body: Define any required engine migration, deprecation, or different fallback behavior in openclaw/agent-skills and then resynchronize the complete directory.

recommendation.title: Adopt canonical policy
recommendation.body: Merge the exact canonical tree and accept Codex, Claude, and Pi plus Sol/high with the narrow Terra access fallback as the supported organization-wide workflow.
